svg.title: Run (tp::run): a pull from the start line to its result

g.text: Run (tp::run): a pull from the start line to its result
+step(State&, const pull::Model&, const Rules&, const vehicle::Input&, dt_s) : pull::Output
the run ends at the sled's first stop after it has moved,
measured where it stands, or with a full pull at the track's end;
the clock is steps × dt, exact
